def repos_in(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {C.short_repo(alias) for alias in C.REPOS if re.search('(?<![a-z0-9])' + re.escape(alias) + '(?![a-z0-9])', text.lower())}

class PageSource(HTMLParser):
    """Only explicit metadata and document headings express page ownership."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.metadata: set[str] = set()
        self.headings: list[str] = []
        self.heading = False

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        if tag in ('title', 'h1'):
            self.heading = True
        if tag == 'meta':
            fields = dict(attrs)
            if (fields.get('name') or '').lower() == 'orchestra-repos':
                self.metadata.update(repos_in(fields.get('content') or ''))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
        if tag in ('title', 'h1'):
            self.heading = False
            self.headings.append(' ')

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if self.heading:
            self.headings.append(data)

def match_pages(it: dict, iid: str, repo: str, pages: list[str], *, number_repos: dict[str, set[str]], html: dict) -> None:
    keys = set(it['slugs']) | {iid}
    nums = {str(x['number']) for x in (it['issue'], it['pr']) if x}
    repo = C.short_repo(repo or '')
    for name in pages:
        stem = name.removesuffix('.html')
        tokens = set(re.split('[-_.]', stem))
        slug_match = any((k in stem for k in keys if len(k) > 6))
        numbers = nums & tokens
        if not (slug_match or numbers):
            continue
        source = PageSource()
        source.feed(page_text(name, html))
        scope = source.metadata or repos_in(stem) or repos_in(''.join(source.headings))
        if scope:
            if repo not in scope:
                continue
        elif 'issue' in tokens:
            if not any((number_repos.get(n) == {repo} for n in numbers)):
                continue
        elif not slug_match:
            continue
        bucket = it['pages'][classify_page(name)]
        if name not in bucket:
            bucket.append(name)
